title: Soin du visage : comment choisir celui qui convient à votre peau ?
Facials: how to choose the right one for your skin
soin-visage-choisir-selon-type-de-peau.excerpt_en: Dry, combination, oily or mature: every skin type has its own needs. Here is how to choose the facial that will truly do you good.
soin-visage-choisir-selon-type-de-peau.cover_alt_en: Gua sha facial at OPAAL Beauty Club in Marrakech
soin-visage-choisir-selon-type-de-peau.seo_title_en: Which facial should you choose for your skin? | OPAAL Marrakech
soin-visage-choisir-selon-type-de-peau.seo_description_en: Dry, combination, oily or mature skin: our advice for choosing the right facial in Marrakech, whether hydrating, radiance, purifying or anti-ageing.
soin-visage-choisir-selon-type-de-peau.content_en:
A successful facial always starts with a simple question: what does your skin need today? Between the Marrakech sun, the dry air and the pace of everyday life, it changes with the seasons. Here are our guidelines to help you make the right choice.

## Dry or tight skin: focus on hydration
Skin that feels tight after cleansing, shows lines quickly or looks dull lacks water and lipids. A **hydrating facial** restores suppleness and comfort: the skin is plumped and the complexion more even.

## Dull or tired complexion: the radiance facial
Lack of sleep, stress, pollution… When your complexion loses its glow, a **radiance facial** brings a real boost of freshness. Combined with a massage, it stimulates microcirculation for a visibly rested face.

## Combination to oily skin: the purifying facial
Shine, enlarged pores, small blemishes: the skin needs to be cleansed without being stripped. The **purifying facial** deeply cleanses and refines the skin texture while respecting its balance.

## Mature skin: the anti-ageing facial
Over time, the skin loses firmness and density. The **anti-ageing facial** smooths, firms and restores density for a more toned face.

## And what about gua sha?
The **gua sha facial massage** suits all skin types. Draining and lifting, it decongests the face and enhances any treatment.

## Our tips to make the benefits last
- Cleanse your skin morning and evening, even without make-up
- Apply a cream suited to your skin type every day
- Protect yourself from the sun all year round, even in winter in Marrakech
- Treat yourself to a salon facial regularly to keep your skin glowing

Not sure? During your appointment, we take the time to analyse your skin and recommend the ideal treatment. Discover [our facials](/en/soins#visage) and book your moment at OPAAL Beauty Club, in Amelkis.

title: Soleil de Marrakech : 7 conseils pour protéger et sublimer votre peau
Marrakech sun: 7 tips to protect and enhance your skin
soin-peau-soleil-marrakech.excerpt_en: Heat, generous sunshine, dry air: the Marrakech climate puts skin to the test. Our 7 tips to protect it and keep a radiant complexion.
soin-peau-soleil-marrakech.cover_alt_en: Fresh, luminous skin after a facial
soin-peau-soleil-marrakech.seo_title_en: Marrakech sun: 7 tips for your skin | OPAAL
soin-peau-soleil-marrakech.seo_description_en: Heat, sun and dry air: our beauty therapists’ 7 tips to protect your skin in Marrakech and keep a radiant complexion all year round.
soin-peau-soleil-marrakech.content_en:
In Marrakech, the sun shines more than 300 days a year. A real joy… as long as you protect your skin properly. Heat, UV rays and dry air can dehydrate it, mark it and dull your complexion. Here are our 7 habits to care for it all year round.

## 1. Sun protection, every day
Even in winter and even on hazy days, apply a high-SPF product to your face, neck and décolleté every morning. Reapply if you spend a long time outdoors.

## 2. Hydrate from within
Drink regularly throughout the day, without waiting until you are thirsty. Skin that is well hydrated from within stays more supple and luminous.

## 3. Choose light textures
During the hot months, opt for serums, gels and fluid creams: they hydrate without weighing the skin down.

## 4. Cleanse gently
Sweat and dust clog the pores. Cleanse your skin morning and evening with a gentle product that does not dry it out.

## 5. Soothe after sun exposure
After a day in the sun, reach for a soothing, hydrating treatment to calm any heat.

## 6. Don’t forget your lips and hands
These delicate areas are often forgotten: a protective lip balm and a hand cream make all the difference.

## 7. Treat your skin to a salon facial
After the summer, a **hydrating facial** or a **radiance facial** helps the skin regain comfort and glow. It is also the perfect time to review its needs with a professional.

Your skin deserves the best: discover [our facials](/en/soins#visage) and book your moment of pampering at OPAAL Beauty Club, in Amelkis, Marrakech.
